experiment_design.branch: If the first two repeated A3/400 runs fail the laboratory predeclared repeatability criterion, use the remaining three slots as repeats/control checks instead of adding runs beyond five. This dataset does not identify that laboratory tolerance.
experiment_design.sequence: Randomize the last three run order after the initial repeatability check, record batch and reaction time; do not compare unmatched aging times.
experiment_design.scope: proposal targeted at current decision uncertainty, not a D-optimal or proven globally optimal design; no invented repeatability threshold
